newsitem.title: USA: Masco acquires cabinetry maker Texwood.
newsitem.headline: Masco acquires cabinetry maker Texwood.

text.p: Masco Corp said Monday it has acquired Texwood Industries Inc, a manufacturer of kitchen and bath cabinetry heeadquartered in Duncanville, Texas.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. Texwood anticipates 1997 sales will be in excess of $150 million, home improvement and building products maker Masco said.
"The acquisition of Texwood Industries positions Masco for stronger participation in the economy category of the cabinet industry," Masco chief executive Richard Manoogian said in a news release.
"This segment in the past few years has grown at more than double the rate of the industry and is expected to outperform the industry for several years in the future."
Texwood chief executive officer Bob Ladd and the management team will remain in place, reporting to Masco's cabinet group vice president Ronald Ayers, Masco said.
Masco shares were up 6/16 at 42-5/16 Monday.
